biggest_catch: The $25 reward is paid in Greene Rewards points, not cash — and the referrer must have an active Bank of Greene County Visa Debit Card to receive and redeem them.
catches: Reward is $25 worth of Greene Rewards points, not cash.
The referrer must have an active Bank of Greene County Visa Debit Card to receive and redeem Greene Rewards points.
The referee must be a new customer (not current or recent within 24 months); the account must stay open and in good standing for 60 days.
Limit of 5 referrals per customer per year (i.e., $125/year in points).

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: The Bank of Greene County's official page (tbogc.com/refer-a-friend/) runs a Refer a Friend program paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns $25 worth of Greene Rewards points for each qualifying friend, limited to 5 referrals per year (i.e., $125/year in points).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: fill out the referral form; the friend receives an email with a link to download a referral slip; the friend opens a qualifying account, submits the referral slip (at account opening or within 30 days), and meets the program requirements.

c4.evidence: Timing: both referrer and referee receive $25 worth of Greene Rewards points within 30 days of eligibility confirmation.

eligibility: Bank of Greene County customers with an active Visa Debit Card referring new customers (not current or recent account holders within 24 months).
notes: Both parties earn $25 worth of Greene Rewards points. Bank employees are not eligible for the referrer bonus.
numeric_basis: Per-referral reward of $25.00 in Greene Rewards points.
payout_quote: Refer a friend and you both can earn $25 in Greene Rewards points when they open a new Bank of Greene County account! Limit of 5 referrals per customer per year.
payout_value_note: $25 worth of Greene Rewards points (not cash) per qualified referral.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral form is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the official page.

s4.note: Cap: limit of 5 referrals per customer per year (i.e., $125/year in points).

s5.note: Offer live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); no expiration date is published.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: fill out the form; the friend downloads a referral slip from the email link and submits it at account opening or within 30 days.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: be a new customer (not current or recent within 24 months); open a qualifying account; submit the referral slip at account opening or within 30 days; keep the account open and in good standing for 60 days.

steps: Fill out the referral form on The Bank of Greene County's refer-a-friend page.
Your friend receives an email with a link to download a referral slip.
Friend opens a qualifying account and submits the referral slip at account opening or within 30 days.
